For independent inputs with density caps a,b, sup_t E(t-[cUV+alpha U+beta V+gamma])_+^(-1/2)<=4sqrt(2)sqrt(ab/|c|).
If an invertible physical 3x3 block B has all 2x2 principal determinants zero, then ||p_Q||inf<=4(|det B|max_i|B_ii|)^(-1/4), uniformly over affine terms/outside conditioning.

Every fixed real symmetric A of rank>=3 admits a finite explicit physical-entry L-infinity certificate: either a nonsingular principal pair is paid by auto27 or, if all pair determinants vanish, a frustrated-sign principal triple is paid by the new theorem.
